action_items: Optional UX polish: The task brief instructs users to ‘Rotate & Reveal, then spin, then Verify last spin’, but the backend design actually requires the reverse order (spin FIRST, then rotate to reveal the seed used, then verify) — that is how recomputed_matches becomes True. Consider adding a one-line hint below the Provably Fair section (‘Verify shows ‘Verified’ only after you rotate the seed — this reveals what secured your past spins.’) so testers/users don't see ‘Rotate your seed to reveal & fully verify’ when they actually did rotate before spinning.
critical_code_review_comments: Slots spin endpoint response uses the field ‘id’ (mongo doc id) instead of ‘spin_id’. Frontend uses result?.id — fine — but the OpenAPI-ish contract in the brief said ‘spin_id’. Consider aliasing the response field to ‘spin_id’ for clarity/consistency with the verify path parameter naming.

Support Helper login has a transient ~5-15s ‘Incorrect email or password’ window immediately after helper creation (only when the login call is issued from the pytest fixture-shared requests.Session). Direct curl / one-off requests works instantly. Likely stems from a shared TCP connection landing on a specific pod whose users cache is briefly stale. Non-blocking; retry loop mitigates. Worth investigating if there is a users_cache or read-preference (secondary?) somewhere in the auth path.

chatbot_service.py: reply fallback string is generic and never surfaces the underlying LLM error to logs — consider a debug-level log so integration failures with EMERGENT_LLM_KEY don't silently degrade the experience.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 SUPPORT_HELPER (TEST_helper_<ts>@royal11.com), 1 chatbot escalation ticket (R11-0046C9 via UI + one via backend test), and minted +1,000 coins to Temp ZM via UI (backend test also minted 1,000 to a manager). All prefixed TEST_ / traceable.
